correctness.rationale: Balance enforces a common signed circulation and gives a unique decomposition into reciprocal pairs and one oriented triangle type. The non-isolated support is connected for any nonzero parameters on three vertices, so Euler realization is exact. For two positive reciprocal pairs at zero circulation the hub excursions reduce to binary necklaces; singletons occur exactly when one multiplicity is one. With one reciprocal pair and positive circulation the detour allocations are cyclic weak compositions, unique exactly when t=1 or the reciprocal count is one. For the remaining supports, the two explicit base words in each case have matched digrams and unequal cyclic 012 counts, and replacing an edge by its alternating three-edge walk inserts two alternating triples and preserves the old triple counts. This proves all excluded cases. Summing gives both generating functions; their primitive cube-root and minus-one poles do not cancel (the numerator of C has only a simple zero at −1). The fourth-order pole at 1 has coefficient 1/12, giving n³/72, and the singleton formula gives the stated small cases and eventual period. Code size is the number of realizable profiles by taking one representative per deterministic observation. Inspected but did not execute verify.py; the recorded enumeration through length 16 and parameter checks through 100 are supporting finite checks, not the proof.
